purpose: Compact handoff between disposable chats. Git history keeps detail; RETURN keeps only information that changes the next agent's work.

fields.head_commit: Latest material commit if one exists.
fields.useful_delta: Short list of what now exists/works/was learned that did not before.
fields.files_changed: Only important changed paths, not every generated artifact.
fields.shared_discoveries: Mechanisms or knowledge that may help other workstreams.
fields.global_delta_candidates: Subset of shared_discoveries important enough to consider promoting globally.
fields.human_boundary: Exact human action/choice if status is HUMAN_BOUNDARY.
fields.evidence: Minimal tests/observations that materially change confidence.
fields.next_best_action: One concrete continuation, not a generic backlog.

storage: Each workstream may keep one mutable `LAST_RETURN.json`; detailed history remains in Git commits. Do not create a new coordination document per turn unless it adds durable value.
promotion: Only cross-workstream discoveries get promoted to DELTA_FEED. Local details remain in the pack/last return/source history.
